description: Reinstall the operating system on a dedicated server. DESTRUCTIVE AND NOT REVERSIBLE: the disks are wiped — every site, database, mail store, key and config on that machine is gone, and there is no snapshot to go back to the way a VPS has. Make sure the customer has what they need off the box first. Pick os_id with impreza_api_call on /dedicated/{serviceId}/os-images. Bare metal takes far longer than a VPS to come back. Requires the 'manage' scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.
name: impreza_dedicated_reinstall
title: Reinstall dedicated server
